actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The mummy makes two [[/item .mmRottingFist000]] attacks and uses [[/item .mmDreadfulGlare0]].

actions.name: rotting fist
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain Hit Points, its Hit Point maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by [[/r 3d6#HP Max Decrease]]{10 (3d6)} every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.

actions.name: dreadful glare
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=8LmlZfevSQkOxGSN]], one [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=8LmlZfevSQkOxGSN]] the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=8LmlZfevSQkOxGSN]] feet. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn. Success: The target is immune to this [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Dreadful Glare for 24 hours.
